replies.text:
Check of commonly-missed threats:

- Automated abuse reachable by anyone: design says "The catalogue search API is public" and "paged 500 at a time with no limit on how many pages a client can read" — present, but already covered by agreed threats 3 (bulk scraping) and 4 (deep paging / expensive filters).
- Staff/admin/moderator screens showing other people's content: design has no such screen (only "The catalogue search API is public") — not present.
- Deleting, moderating, refunding, role changes or money movement without a record: design describes only search ("turns the filter into a database query") — not present.
- Personal/financial documents or pages browsers, proxies or CDNs could cache: design mentions no personal or account documents, only catalogue results — not present.
- Attacker-controlled text flowing into logs, CSV/spreadsheet exports, emails or headers: design mentions no logging, export, email or header sink — not present.
- Single-reviewer item 1 (costly filter expressions): same attack as agreed threat 4 — duplicate.
- Single-reviewer item 2 (client-supplied paging/page-size): design only states "Results are paged 500 at a time with no limit on how many pages a client can read"; it never says page size or offset comes from the client, so this depends on how it might be built — excluded.
